It copies events one way from the TimeTree calendars you pick into one Google calendar on this phone, about every hour. It never writes to TimeTree. If you edit a copy, the edit lasts until the event changes in TimeTree; a deleted copy comes back. Reminders follow the Google calendar\'s defaults.

TimeTree → this phone → your Google calendar. The app talks only to TimeTree. Google Calendar\'s own sync uploads the copies to your Google account. There is no server of our own, no analytics and no tracking.

Your TimeTree email and password are stored on this phone, encrypted with a key that never leaves Android\'s Keystore. The app needs them to sign in again when TimeTree ends the session, about every two weeks. They are excluded from backups and deleted when you sign out.
TT Calendar Sync is not made by or affiliated with TimeTree. It uses TimeTree\'s unofficial web API, which can change at any time. Then syncing stops until the app is updated.
